name: MonarchMarketingHero
title: MarketingHero
summary: The opening of a welcome, launch or onboarding screen: an eyebrow, a large title, a lead, the actions, a note and optional media, on a subtle wash of the product accent.
whenToUse: At the top of a signed-out welcome screen or a product tour, once per screen.
whenNotToUse: For the title of a signed-in screen, use a Material 3 top app bar. For a band further down, use MonarchMarketingSection.
api: @Composable fun MonarchMarketingHero(title: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, eyebrow: String? = null, lead: String? = null, note: String? = null, align: MonarchMarketingAlign = MonarchMarketingAlign.Center, wash: Boolean = true, media: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, actions: (@Composable FlowRowScope.() -> Unit)? = null)

options.name: title
options.description: The main line, in the display style, read as a heading.

options.name: eyebrow
options.description: A short line above the title in the accent, such as the product name.

options.name: lead
options.description: One or two sentences under the title, in the muted colour.

options.name: note
options.description: A small muted line under the actions.

options.name: align
options.description: Centred, or at the start edge.

options.name: wash
options.description: Whether the subtle accent wash is drawn behind the hero.

options.name: media
options.description: An illustration below the text, such as a MonarchProductFrame.

options.name: actions
options.description: The buttons; they wrap onto more lines when needed. Give them the full shape and the large size, as the web's pill-shaped hero buttons.

states.name: start
states.description: Every line starts at the start edge.

appearance: The eyebrow uses the strong accent, the title the default text colour in the display style, the lead and note the muted colour. The wash fades from the subtle accent to the canvas. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web hero owns the page's h1, uses fluid display type that grows with the window and a radial gradient wash. On Android the title is the screen's heading in the display style of the type scale, which follows the font size setting, and the wash is a vertical gradient. Actions are a slot, so the app passes MonarchButtons with the full shape and the large size.
accessibility: The title is a heading; eyebrow, lead and note are plain text in reading order.
The hero is a traversal group, so its lines are read before the actions.
Text wraps at font scale 2.0 and the actions wrap onto more lines.
edgeCases: A long title wraps over several lines; keep it short.
Without actions the note follows the lead.

examples.title: Centered
examples.code:
MonarchMarketingHero(
    title = "Write it once. Find it whenever.",
    eyebrow = "Rook Example",
    lead = "Structured documents for teams whose decisions need to stay connected.",
    note = "Set up in under five minutes.",
) {
    MonarchButton(
        text = "Start writing",
        onClick = {},
        variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Primary,
        size = MonarchButtonSize.Lg,
        shape = MonarchTheme.shapes.full,
    )
    MonarchButton(
        text = "See how it works",
        onClick = {},
        size = MonarchButtonSize.Lg,
        shape = MonarchTheme.shapes.full,
    )
}
